heroHeadline: Bad Bunny Denied $465K in Legal Fees Despite Winning Dismissed Copyright Suit
heroSubtitle: Days after closing the record-breaking Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour at Estadio Hiram Bithorn on August 23 — 57 shows, roughly 3.1 million tickets, and a homecoming stand that doubled as a platform against Puerto Rico's water crisis and the Proyecto Esencia megaproject — a federal judge dealt Bad Bunny a smaller setback off stage. U.S. District Judge Otis D. Wright II ruled that Bad Bunny cannot recoup $465,612 in legal fees from Nigerian producer Dera and emPawa Africa, even though their copyright suit over "Enséñame a Bailar" (sampling Dera's "Empty My Pocket") had already been dismissed after Dera abandoned the case. Wright found the original infringement claim "objectively reasonable" and said awarding fees would discourage rights holders from pursuing legitimate disputes.
